# DropSpace 1.1 Beta5

<!-- update-summary: Improves NetEase enhancement installation, version checks and DLC organization, and fixes Liquid Glass appearance and defaults. -->

## Changes

- Manage NetEase enhancement from Settings → DLC, grouped consistently under installed or not installed. Music keeps a bottom navigation card with a brief explanation.
- Fix installation controls becoming unresponsive after removal. Operations show stages, progress, cancellation and errors; forced reinstalls skip redundant pre-install verification.
- Display the actual installed InfLink-rs version. Check once on the first foreground opening per process and show new versions only inside the enhancement card, without popups or automatic installation.
- Use light text and controls on Liquid Glass, including after switching from Light Acrylic. Choose Ink glass or Ultra-clear glass in the appearance selector; Acrylic keeps its saved theme.
- Default glass blur to 2. The former 200% expanded refraction width effect now corresponds to 100%, preserving existing visual settings.
- Update component classification terminology across all ten interface languages.

v1.1.0-beta.4 is the immediate upgrade baseline for this release.

## Validation scope

Focused local checks, full App/XAML compilation and release artifact integrity checks are used. Broad regression suites and model inference reruns are skipped at the owner's request. Existing native heap stability limitations remain unresolved.
